subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow diagnostic details are safe and useful to show in user-visible channel replies across Discord, webchat, CLI, and auto-reply fallbacks?
rationale: The code already has much of the diagnostic data, but exposing raw session/channel/model/token details is a product and privacy policy choice that automation should not settle.

options.title: Approve redaction-aware diagnostics
options.body: Show safe display labels plus model and token budget facts through a shared formatter, with raw identifiers redacted or omitted by default.

options.title: Keep details in logs/status only
options.body: Preserve generic channel replies and rely on debug logs or diagnostic status for operator-level context details.

options.title: Defer to broader compaction visibility
options.body: Leave this narrow issue open or fold it into a larger compaction visibility design that also covers warnings, notifications, and recovery UX.

recommendation.title: Approve redaction-aware diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show safe display labels plus model and token budget facts through a shared formatter, with raw identifiers redacted or omitted by default.
